task.title: Retrieving active configuration settings by using the API
task.shortdesc: To retrieve Red Hat Quay configuration settings from the command line, you can enable FEATURE_SUPERUSER_CONFIGDUMP and call the v1/superuser/config API endpoint with a superuser OAuth 2 access token. As a Red Hat Quay superuser, you can return all Flask configuration fields that are set, which you can use to show proof of compliance for various security policies, such as PCI-DSS 4.0.

ul.li: You have set FEATURE_SUPERUSER_CONFIGDUMP: true in your config.yaml file.
You have assigned the superuser role to a user in your config.yaml file.
You have generated an OAuth 2 access token for the superuser.
